facts.value: The Student Administration Office is your contact for matters regarding your student status.

Application, Issuance of the Goethe Card (student ID), Semester dates, Semester fees and re-registration, Change of subject, Double degree, Leave of absence, Exmatriculation and reimbursement of fees.
Many issues can be handled online or by post.
The Global Office offers detailed information about studying and living in Frankfurt.
Residence law aspects, Working while studying and questions about work permits, Study financing, Counseling in difficult personal matters.
Self-service for managing personal data, electronic management of study and examination data.
Guidance to ensure accessibility for students with disabilities or chronic conditions is available.
The university offers counseling and support for studying with children.
Expectant mothers should consult the examination office about the new legal regulations regarding maternity protection.
The Antidiscrimination Office provides support for individuals exposed to discrimination.
The Goethe-Uni Law Clinic offers free legal advice on residency, migration, social law, and the application for social benefits.
DGB Campusoffice provides initial legal advice on labor and social law for students.
Tenant Help Association provides rental law advice for students.
